families.page_title: Health protection in children and young people's settings, including education
evidence_points: The collection is a practical guide for staff managing infectious diseases in children and young people’s settings.
It covers education, childcare, children’s social care and parts of the secure estate.
The collection links exclusion, disease-specific, transmission, prevention, immunisation and outbreak resources.
The guidance aims to minimise infection while avoiding unnecessary disruption to face-to-face education and care.
Residential and secure settings may require additional setting-specific interpretation.
The collection is not intended to diagnose infection.

evidence_points: The table is designed for nurseries, childminders, preschools and schools.
It states whether an infected person should stay away and for how long.
It identifies circumstances in which a local health protection team should be contacted.
Where no public-health exclusion is specified, an infected person can normally continue to attend if otherwise well.
The table distinguishes routine exclusions from outbreak or severe-case escalation.
Safeguarding procedures remain necessary when a child’s presentation indicates possible harm or risk.
